name: Stir-fried chicken with chillies & basil
assumptions: Recipe serves 4 as a main with rice (standard for 450g chicken stir-fry per BBC Good Food/Thai style)
Total active time estimated from sequential stir-fry steps (8-10 min + 3 min + 8-10 min) plus reheating, rounded to 30 min
'Soy Sauce' treated as containing wheat/soy (standard unless specified gluten-free)
Fish sauce treated as containing fish (standard fermented fish product)
No explicit dairy, eggs, tree nuts, peanuts, sesame, shellfish, or milk in listed ingredients
Chillies, shallots, garlic, basil, oil, and sugar introduce no listed allergens
Gluten-free left null due to unspecified soy sauce type and possible cross-contamination in fish sauce
instructions:
Heat a wok or large frying pan until it is very hot, then add 1 tbsp of the oil. When it is very hot, add the chicken and stir-fry over a high heat for 8-10 minutes, until browned all over. Using a slotted spoon, take the chicken from the pan and set aside.

step 2
Reheat the wok and add the remaining oil. Toss in the garlic and shallots and stir fry for 3 minutes, until golden brown.

step 3
Return the chicken to the wok and add the chillies, fish sauce, dark soy sauce and sugar. Stir fry over a high heat for a further 8-10 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. Stir in the basil leaves and serve at once.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Standard vegetable oil; 1 tbsp ≈ 14 g, total 2 tbsp used in recipe for stir-frying chicken and aromatics.

ingredients.name: Chicken
ingredients.assumptions: Raw boneless skinless chicken breast/thigh meat as typical for Thai stir-fry; entire 450 g line used, cooked in recipe but nutrition on raw basis per standard practice.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: Chopped raw garlic cloves; 1 tbsp chopped garlic ≈ 9 g, total 3 tbsp based on typical density.

ingredients.name: Shallots
ingredients.assumptions: Chopped raw shallots; 1 tbsp chopped shallots ≈ 10 g, total 3 tbsp based on typical density and moisture.

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 3 whole fresh red Thai chillies (≈20 g each including stems); edible portion after trimming assumed at 60 g total for stir-fry use.

ingredients.name: Fish Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: Standard fish sauce; 1 tbsp ≈ 18 g, total 2 tbsp as liquid seasoning added directly.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: Dark soy sauce; 1 tsp ≈ 5 g, total 2 tsp (recipe says 'Soy Sauce' but context is dark soy); typical density used.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Granulated white sugar; 1 tsp ≈ 4 g, total 2 tsp as sweetener added directly.

ingredients.name: Basil Leaves
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh Thai holy basil leaves (handful); typical handful ≈ 20 g for final stir-in, using standard fresh basil leaf density.
